scripts.deploy: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; server="${DEPLOY_SSH:?set DEPLOY_SSH=user@host of the Uncloud machine}"; rsync -az --delete --exclude node_modules --exclude .git --exclude .uncloud --exclude ".env*" --exclude .trigger --exclude .svelte-kit --exclude build ./ "$server:src/flybondi.fail/"; ssh "$server" "cd src/flybondi.fail && docker build -q -t flybondi/site:latest sitio-sveltekit && docker build -q -t flybondi/jobs:latest -f jobs/Dockerfile ."; uc deploy -f uncloud.yaml --no-build --recreate -y flybondi flybondi-jobs'
